t.rel: It faces the Democratic Republic of the Congo across the Congo River; their capitals are the two closest in the world, with just a river between them.
t.know: Its capital, Brazzaville, and Kinshasa, capital of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, face each other across one river: the two closest capitals in the world.
t.etext: Oil makes up most exports and government revenue; it also sells timber. Heavy government debt has led it to seek IMF support several times.
